newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BASKET DEALS DOMINATE HUNGARY FX FUTURES TRADE.
newsitem.headline: BASKET DEALS DOMINATE HUNGARY FX FUTURES TRADE.

text.p: Basket deals for the dollar and mark took up most of Hungary's moderate forex futures turnover on Monday.
Three quarters of the Budapest Commodity Exchange's turnover of 3.81 billion forints was for such deals.
Both mark and the dollar weakened for most maturites as the forint strengthened against the currency basket on the spot market and the dollar fell back after weeks of strengthening.

Basket deals, by which dollars and marks are traded in the 30/70 proportion they represent in the central bank's currency basket against which the forint floats, are seen as a way of hedging against large dollar/mark fluctuations.
Turnover on the smaller Budapest Stock Exchange was 1.177 billion forints.
